description:
Meet the characters of Annihilated in this latest trailer for the upcoming dark dungeon crawler roguelike deck builder game with anime visual novel-styled narrative. Annihilated will be available on Steam on July 22, 2026.

In Annihilated, you play as the last survivor of a rescue team on a life-or-death mission to find the legendary Hero's party, who disappeared into the depths of a cursed dungeon, which is the enemy itself. Its monsters, traps, and curse turn against anyone who enters, find out what happened to them on each route, borrow the remaining strength of the broken heroes to survive and decide who you'll save, because you won't be able to save everyone.

author: GameTrailers
description:
A new update is out now for White Knuckles. Watch the latest White Knuckles trailer for the horror roguelite speed-climber game to see what to expect with The Nest update, which brings the fifth region, new enemies, new Denizens, new mechanics, new items, a new Endless Mode to be unlocked, and more. 

The Nest introduces White Knuckle’s Fifth Region, an entirely new explorable area within Habitation Blue’s containment sector that houses all remaining creatures who were once subject to experimentation. New enemies abound in The Nest Update, including the return of The Mass, a terrifying, flesh-absorbing entity discovered by the facility's researchers. The Mass can take a new form as The Hunter - an unsettling new enemy that can be slowed, but not stopped. 

Players who beat The Nest in Campaign Mode will unlock an all-new Endless Mode, but the task is not going to be easy: Four new sub-regions will ensure your death at the slightest mistake. 

White Knuckle is available now in PC Early
title: White Knuckle: The Nest - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Emergency Pack for Farming Simulator 25 has arrived, bringing firefighting, rescue services and technical assistance missions to the agri-sim. Watch the latest Farming Simulator 25 trailer to see what to expect with the free Emergency Pack DLC, which expands the responsibilities of virtual farmers with ten emergency situations across four different scenarios on and around local farmlands. The Emergecy Pack DLC for Farming Simulator 25 is available now on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

The Emergency Pack scenarios include fire suppression, technical rescue from wrecked cars, and, most importantly, saving cats from trees. Players extinguish burning pallets, containers, bales and fields, remove obstructive materials from roads, secure oil spills, and more.
title: Farming Simulator 25 - Official Free Emergency Pack Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Enshrouded gets a new trailer and a version 1.0 release date announcement. Watch the latest Enshrouded trailer for this co-op survival action RPG. Enshrouded version 1.0 will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PlayStation 5 (Pro) on October 15, 2026. It is coming to Xbox Series X/S in spring 2027.

Enshrouded is a game of survival, action RPG combat, building, and crafting, set within a sprawling voxel-based continent called Embervale. You are Flameborn, the last ember of hope for a dying race. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls, and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG. Endure the corrupting fog that plagues the land to seek rare treasures and frightening creatures within it, and to reclaim your kingdom's lost beauty and history. Beneath the ruins and within the Shroud lies a story of magic, ruin, and redemption. Awaken the ancient Flame and reclaim the hope that once illuminated this fallen world.
title: Enshrouded - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest trailer for The Last Caretaker to see what to expect with Update 5: New Horizons for the first-person survival base-building sandbox game. The update brings Project Eden, a new progression path that turns committee progress into visible change within the world. The update also features the Committees Awaken: new ways for humans in orbit to influence the future through long-term development goals; Project Jonah introduces a new whale encounter, questline, lore, rewards, and a dedicated encounter location; Cultural Memories that expand the world's history; new tools and systems, and enhanced localization for Italian and Spanish in-game text translations have been added. 

The Last Caretaker is out now in Early Access, and Update 5: New Horizons is available now on Steam and Epic Games Store.
title: The Last Caretaker - Official Update 5: New Horizons Trailer

description:
